strips.title: A day with the O-Cedar spin mop — in real life

panels.head: Saturday, 9 a.m.
panels.text: Vera fills the bucket, adds a squirt of floor cleaner and dunks the head. The foot pedal does the wringing.

panels.head: 5 to 7 pumps
panels.text: O-Cedar's use-and-care page says to pump the pedal 5 to 7 times. More pumps, drier head, fewer streaks.

panels.head: The weak spot
panels.text: Owners most often report the handle loosening or snapping. Tighten the connector and do not lean on it.

panels.head: Afterwards
panels.text: Step on the head to pop it off, machine wash without bleach or softener, and let it dry flat.
